title: Determining the Winner in Alternating-Move Games
summary: We provide a criterion for determining the winner in two-player win-lose alternating-move games on trees, in terms of the Hausdorff dimension of the target set. We focus our study on special cases, including the Gale-Stewart game on the complete binary tree and a family of Schmidt games, generalizing a result of Schmidt from Hilbert spaces to arbitrary complete metric spaces.
